<p style="font-size:1.2em">
As a scientist, one of the major challenges, besides meaningful research itself, is to bring your research to the community. To overcome this challenge, I wanted to make research topics easier accessible through R packages. In this process, I created <a href="https://github.com/braemd/pmxNODE">pmxNODE</a>, a package to facilitate the implementation of low-dimensional NODEs in pharmacometric software, and <a href="https://github.com/braemd/optiDoseR">optiDoseR</a>, a package to generate code for the optiDose approach in pharmacometric software.

This website is dedicated to present tutorials for these packages and other topics of my research.

If you're interested in my research topics and want to apply some methods in your projects or would like to tailor my R packages to your workflow, feel free to reach out any time.
</p>

My research is based on three pillars:
